method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Compilation No. 7 of the Housing Australia Act 2018 (No. 65, 2018), compilation date 11 December 2024 (register id C2024C00857; amendments up to Act No. 136, 2024), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/C2018A00065.txt. The Housing Australia Investment Mandate Direction 2018 (the Home Guarantee Scheme's criteria, limits and deposit) is not deposited; its figures are inputs. No s 51(3) determination is deposited; the day is an input.

checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: From the seat of the first home buyer asking about the Home Guarantee Scheme: to whom a guarantee can be issued (s 8(1B): constitutional corporations, so the lender, not the buyer); whether a guarantee behind the buyer's loan is within what the Act allows (ss 10(2)-(5), 12(3), 13(b)(iia), (c)(ii)), with the Investment Mandate's criteria and limits as inputs; the deposit the Mandate's percentage requires (an input; the Act sets none); the buyer's position under the guarantee agreement (s 10(5)-(7): not a party); Commonwealth backing of Housing Australia's payments and the s 51(2), (3) cut-off day; the s 48A appropriation; s 14(1)(a)(iia) (no direction about a particular guarantee); and the s 3 object's named buyers. Not encoded: the Investment Mandate itself, the financing and capacity building functions, the Help to Buy functions, and the machinery (Board, CEO, staff, Special Account, capital, dividends, borrowing, tax, delegation, reports, reviews, rules).
seat: the first home buyer asking about the Home Guarantee Scheme (5% deposit)
lives: chloe c051 (2028): Byford house-and-land package, $620,000, five per cent deposit -- the guarantee is the lender's, within the Act if the Investment Mandate's criteria are met; deposit $31,000 at an input 5%; Commonwealth-backed
